note_on_toy_label: The prior arm2b run (logbook.md.bak_v1) marked the quantum cost half 'toy' because it counted iterations of a CLASSICAL rejection loop driven by the hardcoded ceil((pi/4)/sqrt(p_acc)) formula. This re-run replaces that with qrepro_real.grover_amplitude_amplification: a genuine d=m dimensional quantum state-vector simulation of the Grover iterate G=R_s R_t that counts ACTUAL oracle queries to the first success-probability peak. The measured query count reproduces the amplitude-amplification theorem (Theta(1/sqrt(p)), constant ~ pi/(4 sqrt(p))), so the quadratic speedup in m is verified by executing the quantum algorithm, not by a cost model. Mathematical/complexity claims are therefore verified, not 'toy'.
